name: aurora
title: Aurora
description: Curtains of northern light hang across a night sky: a sharp lower hem, fading upward in vertical rays, folding slowly. A small WebGL shader draws it; a CSS poster stands in everywhere else.

meta.reducedMotion: A designed still, not a frozen frame: a long-exposure plate. The curtains settle into three smooth ribbons of the same two colours over a dark ridge, under circular star trails; no canvas is mounted.
meta.useWhen: The subject is the far north, night, cold, observation, polar travel or a planetarium: behind a hero or a single quiet section.
meta.avoidWhen: As a generic "AI glow" background; behind body copy; light themes; pages that already run WebGL.
